data.title: 藤原千花 · 钢琴房夕照下的四手联弹
data.description: 夕阳染红整间音乐活动室，金色光尘在黑白三角钢琴边起舞。千花身穿典雅的海军蓝褶裙，并肩坐在琴凳上指导指法。当少年的手覆上她的指尖按下和弦时，向来大大咧咧的千花突然停下了弹奏，红着耳尖转过脸，罕见地露出了真正千金名媛的心动与羞怯。
data.location: grand piano music hall with sunset windows
data.action: hands overlapping on piano keys, turning with intense blush, sunset glow
data.lighting: dramatic crimson and golden sunset streaming through windows
data.promptProse: Seated side-by-side on the piano bench during a fiery sunset, Fujiwara Chika plays a four-hand duet. When their hands overlap on the ivory keys, her cheerful persona melts into a breathtakingly shy, aristocratic blush in the golden light.
data.animaCaption: Chika blushing shyly as hands overlap on the piano keys at sunset.
